descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S22 「面板和 p72 原型一致；故意的不同列给 Daniela」 Panel matches the p72 prototype; deliberate deviations listed for Daniela

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'.（TFA-92594 AC 1）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Prototype TranscriptHistory (handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html :6680-6760) and the app's TranscriptHistoryPanel

When Compare side by side: placement on the Encounter tab, row layout, history icon, '{n} lines' chip, chevron, inner scroll height, Physician/Patient colours, grouping above four sessions, order

Then Matches the prototype, except for deviations Daniela accepts (Q11)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side review. The behavioural parts (one open at a time, grouping) are automated in S01/S07. Deviations Daniela accepts are Q11. The prototype's retention (per-stay bedside history, ~48 h archive, three Nursing Home visits) conflicts with AC 2 / 3.6 and is Q12: a Fail on S10, S11 or S23 is not routed back as 'built to the prototype' until Q12 is answered

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
